remarks: This move-in ready 1955 split level home in Coleytown offers 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and sits on a spacious 1 acre level lot. The location is convenient, with close proximity to schools, restaurants, shopping, and playgrounds, making it an ideal place for families.  The above grade lower level of the home features a versatile 4th bedroom/office, playroom, full bath, laundry room, and mudroom with direct access to the garage. This layout provides ample space for families to spread out and enjoy. Step outside to the private backyard, where you can entertain and relax with family and friends. This property boasts a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life, while still being just moments away from top-rated schools, pristine beaches, and a wealth of amenities. The home is filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for residents and guests alike. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make this charming home your own. Make it yours and start creating lasting memories in this wonderful community. Not a Drive-By!
